name: Dakota Automotive Products, Inc
old_description: We provide a service to customers and auto dealerships in eastern South Dakota, southwest Minnesota, northwest Iowa and northeast Nebraska as an expeditor and installer of a full range of leather interiors, seat comfort products and automotive electronic accessories.
about:
Dakota Automotive Products, Inc. operates from Alcester, South Dakota, serving auto dealerships across eastern South Dakota, southwest Minnesota, northwest Iowa, and northeast Nebraska. The company's founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company functions as an expeditor and installer, providing a range of automotive aftermarket products including leather interiors, seat comfort systems, remote starters, rear-seat entertainment, advanced driver assistance systems, factory OE radio upgrades, SiriusXM add-ons, and power sunroofs. It supplies and installs these items for dealerships, enabling them to offer individual features that are otherwise bundled in higher trim packages.

Its primary customers are automotive dealerships in the four-state region. By acting as a distributor and installer, Dakota Automotive Products allows dealerships to sell single-item upgrades—such as a remote start or leather seating—without requiring the customer to purchase an entire option package.

The company states that its service saves customers thousands of dollars compared to factory-ordered packages, and it emphasizes providing products with the highest quality, performance, and warranty to ensure satisfaction.
